title: Set B – Cotton T-shirts from Turkey by truck (2 seeded discrepancies + HS warning)
scenario: Clothing wholesaler imports knitted cotton T-shirts from Istanbul, CPT Tashkent, Turkish truck, enters at Alat (Bukhara), cleared at Tashkent-tovarniy. CMR is wrong on packages and gross weight; seller's invoice shows the wrong HS subheading. Shows: specific minimum (0.5 USD/pc) beats ad valorem; inland-freight deduction under Art. 305.
rates_note: EXAMPLE exchange rates (not CBU data): 1 USD = 12 100.00 UZS, 1 CNY = 1 700.00 UZS. Replace with the CBU rate on the GTD acceptance date (Customs Code Art. 326; Instruction 2773 grafa 23).
assumptions: Packing list and invoice are correct; CMR is the erroneous document (carrier must issue a corrected CMR or the declarant must explain) – expected GTD values below assume the corrected state.
Inland carriage 450 USD deducted under Customs Code Art. 305 (separately documented). Without the carrier statement CV would be 12 600 USD.
Specific minimum 0.5 USD/pc × 6 000 = 3 000 USD > 20% × 12 150 = 2 430 USD → specific applies (Customs Code Art. 293 'not less than', per data/tariff).
UZS amounts rounded half-up to 2 decimals – official rounding rule for grafa 47 not confirmed ⚠️.
VAT = 12% × (customs value + duty + excise) per Tax Code Arts. 254, 258 as used in data/tariff (no excise for these codes).
Additional duty (code 21, Customs Code Art. 300¹ per data/tariff) NOT applied: origin is documented and the country is on the MFN list (data/tariff/tariff_demo.json common.mfn_list_url).
Grafa 46 computed from customs value (assumes customs value ≈ CIP/CIF border value) ⚠️.
